name: Group Mention
description: Enable @group mentions for Mattermost Community Edition. Create custom groups and mention all members at once.

settings_schema.header: Configure group mention behavior and limits for your Mattermost instance.

settings.help_text: Maximum number of users that can be notified from a single group mention. Prevents spam in large groups.
Maximum number of group mentions allowed in a single message.

settings.display_name: Rate Limit: Mentions Per User Per Minute
settings.help_text: Maximum group mentions a user can send per minute.

settings.display_name: Rate Limit: Mentions Per Channel Per Minute
settings.help_text: Maximum group mentions allowed in a channel per minute.

settings.display_name: Rate Limit: Times A Group Can Be Mentioned Per Minute
settings.help_text: Maximum times a specific group can be mentioned per minute.

settings.display_name: Allow Regular Users to Create Groups
settings.help_text: If enabled, any user can create and manage groups. If disabled, only team/channel admins can manage groups.
Default visibility setting for new groups.

options.display_name: Public (all users can see and use)
Private (only owners can see member list)

settings.help_text: How group mentions should be handled: notify-only keeps @groupname as-is and sends notifications; text-expand replaces @groupname with individual @mentions in the message.
Number of channel members above which a channel is considered 'large'.

settings.display_name: Require Channel Admin in Large Channels
settings.help_text: If enabled, only channel admins can use group mentions in large channels.
Enable detailed debug logs for troubleshooting.
